scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend/admin && npm install --prefix frontend/storefront
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,ADMIN,STORE -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend/admin" "npm run dev --prefix frontend/storefront"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend/admin && npm run build --prefix frontend/storefront
